timezone_note: Research date 20 Nov 2026, Asia/Saigon (UTC+7). Source pages are dated the same day unless a note says otherwise.
scope: New launches in areas already covered by the 143-project map only (Subang Jaya, Bangsar South, Mont Kiara, KLCC, Bangsar, Bukit Bintang).
excluded_nearby: Puchong, Kinrara, Serdang, Seri Kembangan, Putra Permai (in some Subang Jaya city guides but not on our current map).
Taman D'Kayangan, Juvela (Batu Tiga / Shah Alam).
Pangsapuri Gemilang TWL and Pangsapuri Harmoni TWL (Batu Tiga affordable schemes outside our confirmed map footprints).
Papyrus North Kiara (PropLaunch files this in Segambut, not Mont Kiara).
Dutamas / Segambut / Sri Hartamas projects marketed as “Mont Kiara”.
Pantai Sentral Park / Pantai / Enlace Suites (not Bangsar or Bangsar South on our map).
Completed projects already in real_projects.json (e.g. Laurel Residence, Residensi 38 Bangsar, Residensi TRX 1).

bb_highrise.note: Only Residensi TRX 1 (9.81) and Sunway Velocity Two (5.81).
